_comment: Mermaid config for the SVG kept in the repository.
htmlLabels: false, so the committed vector stays consumable by non-browser tooling.
resvg, CairoSVG, librsvg and the Word and Google Docs importers do not implement
foreignObject; a browser-only SVG would look empty in all of them. This is
future-proofing the repo copy, not a condition on the deliverable -- the PNG is what
Everything else matches mermaid_config_png.json. The two must name the same
fontFamily: the manifest records one font for the run, and the render step refuses
